areas.name: Authentication & Staff Login
areas.description: Staff login mechanisms (username/password, card-swipe, optional streamlined login), session handling, login audit, and role-at-login behavior.

areas.name: Authorization, Permissions & Admin Scope Control
areas.description: Role-based and fine-grained access control for report and operational functions; admin capabilities for managing groups/roles, template edit restrictions, and scoped permissions.

areas.name: Web App UI, Help & Accessibility
areas.description: Web-based report writer interfaces, query UI/UX, interactive help (hierarchical/cross-linked/online), hover tooltips, and accessibility/non-interference with OPAC.

areas.name: Query Builder, Filters & Candidate Selection Engine
areas.description: Relational query capabilities for selecting/reporting entities: field selection, drag-and-drop, boolean logic (AND/OR), complex criteria, LIMIT/GROUP BY, regex/picklists upload files, null inclusion options, and displaying criteria/results.

areas.name: Report Templates, Scheduling, Queue & Outputs
areas.description: Canned and template-based report creation/management, run controls (ad hoc, modifiable vs run-as-is), scheduling/recurrence, queue visibility/status/cancel, report prioritization, pagination/progress, and output formats/exports (CSV/HTML/Excel/email).

areas.name: Analytical Reporting & Reporting Dimensions
areas.description: Core reporting analytics: grouping/aggregation levels, pivot/crosstab outputs, comparative date ranges and side-by-side views, trends, shelf-space proxy/reporting by category attributes, and demographic/inactivity/activity metrics.

areas.name: Location & Consortium Multi-Location Reporting
areas.description: Branch/system/region scope, cross-branch visibility, drill-downs, grouping branches by region/system, local-vs-system average comparisons, and centralized consolidation for multi-library operations.

areas.name: OP Operations: Item Transfer, Revert & Transit Management
areas.description: Batch transfer mechanisms and utilities (picklists/manual selection/query-driven candidate lists), audit/logging, preview/confirm, transaction safety, transit in-transit detection/thresholds/overdue rules, scheduled/conditional auto-revert, and undo for transfers including in-transit report variants.

areas.name: Purge/Weeding & Deletion Utilities
areas.description: Weeding/purge candidate identification with customizable criteria, read-only previews, safeguards to prevent accidental mass deletion, scheduling, deletions with DB triggers/audit persistence, reporting/audit trails, last-copy and WorldCat-support deletion lists, and orphaned record handling.

areas.name: Finance & Transaction Reporting (Fines/Payments/Accounting)
areas.description: Financial tracking and reporting: fines/charges by time/type, waived fines, snapshot/history, payments and instruments, ledger/audit trails, patron account balances, outstanding thresholds, and attachment/joining of financial transactions to records.

areas.name: Collections, Circulation & Capacity/Inventory Analytics
areas.description: Collection usage and volume analytics (acquisitions, circulation breakdowns, item counts by status/genre/format), item value and price/call-number aging, hold counts, uncataloged material tracking, and capacity/shelf-space utilization with color-coded status and central database aggregation.

areas.name: Patron Analytics & Demographic/Inactivity Reporting
areas.description: Patron demographics/behavior statistics, age calculation and configurable age ranges, last activity computation, inactivity thresholds, inclusion/exclusion of nulls/blanks, outstanding fines handling, inactivity/low-balance list generation, and completeness indicators for patron report outputs.

areas.name: Non-Functional Constraints & Platform/Deployment/Compliance
areas.description: Cross-cutting non-functional constraints and platform compatibility: relational backend and reporting replicas/warehouses, enterprise/centralized integration assumptions, performance under load & operational-hour processing, background processing/caching, scalability and large datasets, transaction safety/retention policies/anonymization, availability and cancellation behavior, OPAC isolation/non-interference, accessibility compliance and browser/server OS support.
